notes: Second Kallanka, sector A, Subsector 1, UA 2, Unit 2K, UE 8 Observations; 1) Although fragmentary, this khipu was excavated by G Urton at Incahuasi. The fragments were wrapped together. Therefore, the presumption is that this was a single, united khipu. 2) Excavation: January 11, 2014 (see photos) 3) There are three fragments. 4) UR263 was wrapped together with a smaller khipu, recorded as UR262 5) Fragment #1 is V attached; however, fragments #2 and #3 are R attached. Thus, the sequence of cords recorded in fragment #1 (which ends at cord 108) should be reversed, to coincide with cord order in fragments #2 and #3 6) Nickname: Khipu Urton 7) Fragments: 59.5 cm + 13 cm + 50 cm.
